item.description: From 00.0s to 04.0s, a high-angle camera pans slowly from right to left along a low brick wall built on sandy soil, showing a corner junction on the right and a top course of red bricks laid on edge in parallel pairs separated by crosswise header bricks, leaving open rectangular vertical cavities between them with no mortar applied yet to the vertical joints of the top course. Grey mortar is visible in the lower courses and spilled along the sandy base. Around 04.0s, as the camera continues panning left toward the left corner junction, a worker's feet in sandals and dark trousers walk into the upper left background near a pointed trowel lying on the ground (04.0s–07.0s). From 07.0s to 09.6s, the worker bends down and uses both hands to lower a long silver metal straightedge bar horizontally onto the top edge of the unmortared brick-on-edge course to check or align the course; the camera pans slightly left to show the left corner of the L-shaped wall while the worker's hands remain holding and adjusting the bar until the clip ends at 09.6s.
item.context_result: The open internal cavities and staggered header-stretcher arrangement of the brick-on-edge course between two corners are clearly shown, and the straightedge rests along the top course while still held by the worker at clip end.
item.camera_framing: High-angle medium close-up panning steadily from the right corner junction leftward to the left corner junction.
item.uncertainty: The top course of bricks on edge has no mortar in its vertical joints yet (appearing dry-placed or only bedded below prior to full jointing), and the clip cuts off at 09.6s while the worker is still holding the straightedge on the wall.

item.claim: The wall demonstrates the geometry of Rat-Trap Bond masonry, with bricks placed on edge in parallel stretcher pairs and cross headers forming internal rectangular cavities and L-shaped corner junctions.
item.uncertainty: While the brick-on-edge cavity geometry is directly visible, the top course lacks vertical joint mortar at this stage, and thermal insulation or structural strength properties are inferred from script and background knowledge rather than measured in the video.

item.uncertainty: The clip ends at 09.6s while the worker is still holding the straightedge against the bricks, so the outcome of any alignment adjustment is not shown.
